component.name: Lazy Ports
component.summary: Manage local dev services and ports from the COSMIC panel

description.p: Lazy Ports is a COSMIC panel applet for managing local development services and listening ports. It scans local TCP ports, lets you pin services with start commands, open ports in the browser, view live logs, and stop or kill processes — all from the panel.

Lazy Ports ships with its own dark instrument skin by default, with an optional System theme available in Preferences. The Listening Ports rail starts collapsed, action glyphs stay legible at rest, and long service names are truncated cleanly instead of overlapping the action buttons.

Skin-first default: the applet ships with its own dark instrument skin and an optional System theme in Preferences. Listening Ports rail starts collapsed. Action glyphs are legible at rest. Long service names ellipsise instead of overlapping action buttons. Preferences rows keep a readable label column.
System COSMIC theme by default with optional industrial look; multi-port group rows fixed.
